story.title: A brand without a final name.
paragraphs: This is the local foundation of a future beef jerky brand. The name, mark, and pack are temporary and meant to be replaced.
The product comes first: flavor, texture, and quiet photography. No cowboy costume and no loud promises.
Recipes, trials, and batch costs stay in a private workshop. The site shows only what can already be said honestly.
The first market is Poland. Polish is the default language.

items.a: You can save only a local test order on this computer. There is no payment and no shipping.
The planned retail format is 100 g per pack.
Ingredients, allergens, and nutrition stay unpublished until the recipe is confirmed.
A public average uses approved reviews only. There are none yet. Workshop scores are not shown to customers.

privacyBody: A test order stores the name, email, phone, and address in the local MySQL database on this computer.
A local account stores the name, email, and a password hash in the same database. The password itself is not stored and is not sent anywhere.
That data is not sent to payments, email, or a courier. The contact form stays switched off.
Before a public sale, this text must be replaced with a reviewed privacy notice.
termsBody: Only a local test order can be saved. No payment is taken, and the order is not passed to a seller or a courier.
Flavor descriptions are drafts. They are not statements about ingredients, meat origin, or product properties.
Real terms for purchase, delivery, and returns are required before any sale.
